queries.text: Why did OpenAI release o3 and o4-mini in April 2025, and what did the launch signal about the direction of frontier reasoning models?
Official OpenAI blog post or press release date for the launch of o3 and o4-mini
List of technical specifications (parameter count, context window) disclosed by OpenAI for o3 and o4-mini in April 2025
Comparison table of benchmark scores (e.g., AIME, GPQA Diamond, SWE-bench Verified) between o1/o3-pro and o3/o4-mini published by OpenAI
Number of API requests processed per day on OpenAI's platform immediately following the April 2025 launch compared to pre-launch baseline
